title: Jip and Janneke bake biscuits.
lines: Jip lives in a house with a garden.
Janneke lives next door to Jip.
There's a hedge between their gardens.
There's a hole in the hedge.
Jip can crawl through the hole to Janneke.
Tap, tap, tap on the window.
Jip and Janneke can't play outside.
Mummy puts everything on the table.
Flour, butter, sugar and an egg.
Jip may put the flour in the bowl.
One spoon, two spoons, three spoons.
A little flour falls on the floor.
The egg falls into the bowl.
But a bit of shell does too.
They knead the dough with their hands.
Mummy rolls the dough flat with a rolling pin.
Now Jip and Janneke may cut out shapes.
The biscuits go into the oven.
They sweep the flour off the floor.
They have to cool down first.
Jip says: Let's give one to Daddy.
And one to the lady next door.
Janneke says: And one to Takkie.
But Takkie's biscuit isn't for dogs.
Jip and Janneke run outside with their biscuits.
Through the hole in the hedge.
